LanguageData.MATR.LetterTextAnimaTreeNaturalBlessingB: {PAWN_labelShort} has successfully requested for a natural blessing from the anima tree without any negative consequences. {PAWN_pronoun} can now meditate in nature and link with the anima tree to get psychic powers.

{PAWN_labelShort} has successfully requested for a natural blessing from the anima tree. {PAWN_pronoun} can now meditate in nature and link with the anima tree to get psychic powers. However, {PAWN_labelShort} was not able to take the blessing properly. {PAWN_pronoun} was psychically shocked.
Regrettably, the anima tree has rejected {PAWN_labelShort}'s request for a natural blessing. {PAWN_pronoun} must wait for 20 days to get the highest chances possible to get a natural blessing.
Not only has the anima tree rejected {PAWN_labelShort}, the anima tree has also given a punishment. {PAWN_labelShort} now has paralytic abasia.
LanguageData.MATR.RitualRoleAlreadyNaturalBlessed: Must be a colonist that has not yet been given a natural blessing from the anima tree.
LanguageData.MATR.RitualTargetAnimaTreeCannotBeUsedBy: Anima tree cannot be requested for a natural blessing. There must be at least one non-psychically deaf, adult colonist who does not yet have a natural blessing.
LanguageData.MATR.AnimaSootheConjurationExplanationBa: The anima soothe conjuration ritual's soothing effect strength is based on its outcome. To get higher chances to get the best outcomes, the rituals should have more participants.\n\nWith {0} additional participants, {1} anima grass will be restored at the end of the conjuration if done masterfully.
LanguageData.MATR.AnimaSootheConjurationCompletionBas: The anima soothe conjuration was successfully done. Everyone in the surrounding region will feel the soothing effect from the ritual.
LanguageData.MATR.AnimaSootheConjurationCompletionMas: Since the ritual was done masterfully, anima grass will regrow based on the ritual's quality.
LanguageData.MATR.AnimaSootheConjurationCompletionNeg: However, something went wrong with the conjuration ritual. As a result, the soothing effect is not as strong as it should be.
LanguageData.MATR.AnimaSootheConjurationCompletionWor: Even worse, the ritual's organizing conjurer was psychically shocked and will need some time to recover.
LanguageData.MATR.LetterTextRitualCompletedAnimaGrass: A total of {0} anima grass was restored.
